items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Then Earl Bostic got a band, a small band. ... you hear Earl Bostic

ctx.x: No, she worked with a band. And boy, it was a swingin' little band. Little cat looked like Baby Dodds. She had a swingin' little band, one of them rhythm-and-blues bands in California. The Honey Drippers. Then they had what... Then Earl Bostic got a band, a small band.
Brown. What's that guy's name? Brown. Buddy...
